exposure: Second twins born after a delivery interval > 30 min
breech presentation of the first twin
presentation of the first twin (breech vs cephalic)
cohort: 354 twin deliveries at a tertiary Norwegian hospital, with planned vaginal delivery and gestational age ≥ 34 weeks
finding: While the median umbilical arterial pH was lower in second twins regardless of labor onset, a delivery interval > 30 minutes was associated with a significantly lower pH in the second twin.
mod_finding: Intrapartum cesarean section rates did not differ significantly between spontaneous and induced labors in twin pregnancies.
